newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kwong Sang Hong says NAV at HK$5.58/shr.
newsitem.headline: Kwong Sang Hong says NAV at HK$5.58/shr.

text.p: Kwong Sang Hong International Ltd said on Tuesday its pro forma adjusted unaudited consolidated net asset value (NAV) was HK$5.58 per share as at January 9.
The company said the consideration payable for each Kwong Sang Hong share under a privatisation proposal would be HK$4.37, representing a discount of 22 percent to the NAV.

In December, Peregrine Investments Holdings Ltd had said it would privatise its 51.9 percent owned Kwong Sang Hong by offering 200 Peregrine shares plus HK$1,700 cash for every 1,000 Kwong Sang Hong shares.

The Kwong Sang Hong statement said the privatisation proposal would become effective on February 21 and its listing withdrawn from the exchange on February 24 if shareholders gave the green light at a special general meeting on February 5.
"Peregrine has no plans to change the management of KSH (Kwong Sang Hong)," Peregrine chairman Philip Tose said in the statement.
"It has no current plans to dispose of or redeploy any major investment property interests of KSH, inject new major property interests or to change significant KSH's business activities."

Peregrine said earlier that the privatisation proposal was made because the market did not consider Kwong Sang Hong a first tier Hong Kong-listed property company and its shares would continue to trade at a substantial discount to their NAV.
Kwong Sang Hong shares closed at HK$4.15 on Monday.
